config.name: cardiac_quadratic_reference_gamg_v1
config.scope: Separate full-cycle solver-equivalence experiment after five accepted fixed-history nonlinear probes. Native GMRES/GAMG with rigid-body near-nullspace; all mechanics, geometry, P2 space, 1.25ms timestep, initial conditions and physical acceptance criteria match the completed direct reference. No direct trajectory is replaced. Compare all800 recursively generated states and whole-element positivity before considering changes to the production solver. This engineering control does not establish mesh/time convergence or select neural models.

kinematics_verification: Affine-field determinant and volume integral verified independently against native UFL; actual-field integral checks are recorded in native_integral_checked_steps.
positivity_scope: Source degree-6 quadrature points and all tetrahedral vertices, endpoint and generalized-alpha stress states; not a mathematical positivity guarantee between sample locations.
